SELECT 
    sp.cloudregistry,
    sp.arcref,
    sp.scanresolmm,
    sp.pointdense,
    sp.coverpct,
    sp.lappct,
    sp.noisedb,
    -- SRI = log10(ScanResolMm * 1000) / log10(PointDense) * 5
    (LOG(sp.scanresolmm * 1000) / LOG(10)) / (LOG(sp.pointdense) / LOG(10)) * 5 AS sri,
    -- SCE = coverpct (assuming this is the coverage percentage)
    sp.coverpct AS sce,
    -- SQS = (10/SRI)^1.5 * (SCE/100) * (1 - NoiseDb/30)^2
    POWER(CAST(10.0 / ((LOG(sp.scanresolmm * 1000) / LOG(10)) / (LOG(sp.pointdense) / LOG(10)) * 5) AS numeric), 1.5) 
        * (sp.coverpct / 100.0) 
        * POWER(1.0 - sp.noisedb / 30.0, 2) AS sqs
FROM scanpointcloud sp
LIMIT 10;

WITH scan_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        sp.cloudregistry,
        sp.arcref,
        sp.scanresolmm,
        sp.pointdense,
        sp.coverpct,
        sp.lappct,
        sp.noisedb,
        -- SRI
        (LOG(sp.scanresolmm * 1000) / LOG(10)) / (LOG(sp.pointdense) / LOG(10)) * 5 AS sri,
        -- SQS
        POWER(CAST(10.0 / (((LOG(sp.scanresolmm * 1000) / LOG(10)) / (LOG(sp.pointdense) / LOG(10)) * 5)) AS numeric), 1.5) 
            * (sp.coverpct / 100.0) 
            * POWER(1.0 - sp.noisedb / 30.0, 2) AS sqs,
        -- Comprehensive Coverage check
        CASE WHEN sp.coverpct >= 95 AND sp.lappct >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_good_coverage
    FROM scanpointcloud sp
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        cloudregistry,
        arcref,
        sqs,
        has_good_coverage,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY arcref ORDER BY sqs DESC) as rank
    FROM scan_scores
),
best_per_project AS (
    SELECT arcref, MIN(rank) as best_rank
    FROM ranked
    WHERE has_good_coverage = 1
    GROUP BY arcref
)
SELECT r.cloudregistry, r.arcref, r.sqs, r.has_good_coverage, r.rank, b.best_rank
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN best_per_project b ON r.arcref = b.arcref
WHERE r.rank > COALESCE(b.best_rank, 999999)
ORDER BY r.arcref, r.rank;
